description.en: Not found in the game. This name is in the list of CMND_* names, but nothing registers it: there is no registration in the IDA or Ghidra decompiles, no call in the shipped scripts and no trace in the ELF's symbol strings. It is most likely a stray list entry, close to CMND_GET_PARAM_ID_RANDOM and DBGCMND_GET_PARAM, which both exist. Calling it from a script would fail because the function does not exist.
No implementation exists to return anything.

examples.case: Use one of the real commands instead (not found in script_clean/; invented)
examples.code:
// CMND_GET_PARAM does not exist; for example, pick a random player instead
local paramHash = CMND_GET_PARAM_ID_RANDOM(0, false);
